page.overview:
Who is Molayne?

Molayne is a character appearing in Pokémon Sun and Pokémon Moon. He is a former Trial Captain and Sophocles's cousin. In Pokémon Ultra Sun and Pokémon Ultra Moon, he replaces Hala as a member of the Elite Four who specializes in types.

Molayne is a man with three-layered hair: the bottom one being dark-colored, the middle one brown, and the top being colored light-colored. His eyes are colored grey. He wears a blue jacket with red stripes around his fore-arms, a teal collared shirt with two stripes tied in a knot, some black pants and shoes. He also has hexagon-shaped glasses with a grey frame.

Molayne and his Japanese name, Maarein, both come from mullein, an alternative name to the plant genus known as verbascum. It could also include molybdenum, a metallic element.

Molayne is a former Trial Captain, who passed the role onto his cousin, Sophocles. Now, Molayne takes care of the Alola's Pokémon Storage System.
